```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4, message = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE)
```

This short example constructs an areal dataset, generates Moran eigenvector maps,
and fits iVAE and iVAEar using the Moran auxiliary option.

```{r areal-generation, message = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(NonlinearBSS)

set.seed(1)
areal <- generate_areal_units(n_area = 30, n_fine = 600,
                             seed_type = "uniform", seed = 1)

src <- simulate_sources_areal(p = 3, areal = areal, n_time = 20,
                              n_segments_time = 5,
                              sd_range = c(0.3, 1.2),
                              ar_range = c(0.4, 0.8), seed = 2)
```

## Example areal sources

The first three latent sources are shown at a single time point over the areal units.

```{r source-plot}
idx <- seq_len(nrow(areal$area_coords))
source_df <- data.frame(
  x = areal$area_coords[idx, 1],
  y = areal$area_coords[idx, 2],
  source1 = src$sources[idx, 1],
  source2 = src$sources[idx, 2],
  source3 = src$sources[idx, 3]
)
source_long <- data.frame(
  x = rep(source_df$x, 3),
  y = rep(source_df$y, 3),
  component = factor(rep(c("Source 1", "Source 2", "Source 3"),
                         each = nrow(source_df)),
                     levels = c("Source 1", "Source 2", "Source 3")),
  value = c(source_df$source1, source_df$source2, source_df$source3)
)

ggplot(source_long, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "x", y = "y", fill = "value")
```

## Moran eigenvector maps

The spatial structure is described by positive Moran eigenvectors of the areal adjacency matrix.

```{r moran-plot}
mem <- compute_MEM_vectors(areal$W, K = 10, positive_only = TRUE)$mem[, 1:3, drop = FALSE]
mem_long <- data.frame(
  x = rep(areal$area_coords[, 1], 3),
  y = rep(areal$area_coords[, 2], 3),
  component = factor(rep(c("MEM 1", "MEM 2", "MEM 3"), each = nrow(areal$area_coords)),
                     levels = c("MEM 1", "MEM 2", "MEM 3")),
  value = as.vector(mem)
)

ggplot(mem_long, aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "x", y = "y", fill = "value")
```

## Fitting iVAE and iVAEar with Moran auxiliary data

```{r tf-models, eval = tf_available()}
coords <- areal$area_coords[rep(seq_len(nrow(areal$area_coords)),
                               length(unique(src$time))), , drop = FALSE]

mix <- mix_data(src$sources, n_layers = 2, nonlinearity = "elu",
                final_activation = "none")

aux_spec <- aux_moran(neighborhood = areal$W, K = 10)

fit_ivae <- iVAE(mix, aux = aux_spec, latent_dim = 3,
                epochs = 10, batch_size = 32, verbose = 0, seed = 1)

fit_ivaear <- iVAEar(mix, aux = aux_spec, latent_dim = 3,
                    coords = coords, time = src$time,
                    epochs = 10, batch_size = 32, verbose = 0, seed = 1)
```

```{r tf-component-plots, eval = tf_available()}
plot_ivae <- data.frame(
  time = src$time,
  component = factor(rep(c("Component 1", "Component 2", "Component 3"),
                         each = nrow(fit_ivae$S)),
                     levels = c("Component 1", "Component 2", "Component 3")),
  value = c(fit_ivae$S[, 1], fit_ivae$S[, 2], fit_ivae$S[, 3])
)

ggplot(plot_ivae, aes(time, value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "time", y = "estimated component")

plot_ivaear <- data.frame(
  time = src$time,
  component = factor(rep(c("Component 1", "Component 2", "Component 3"),
                         each = nrow(fit_ivaear$S)),
                     levels = c("Component 1", "Component 2", "Component 3")),
  value = c(fit_ivaear$S[, 1], fit_ivaear$S[, 2], fit_ivaear$S[, 3])
)

ggplot(plot_ivaear, aes(time, value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ component, ncol = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "time", y = "estimated component")
```
